title: AutomationInvocationResource

automation_id.description: The automation that owns the invocation.

created_at.description: The creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

source.description: Whether the invocation was manual or scheduled.

scheduled_at.description: The intended occurrence as a Unix timestamp in seconds, or null for manual runs.

session_id.description: The target or newly created session ID, or null before one is available.

status.description: Delivery status; completed does not mean the agent's work has finished.

skip_reason.description: Why an occurrence was skipped, or null when it was not skipped.

error.description: The permanent delivery failure, or null when no failure occurred.

description: One attempted delivery by an automation.
